failureDetails.note: Timing-sensitive Home test. This read uses include_week=false and does not exercise the prepared context. The failed timing is retained here; the full run is not claimed green.

unchangedMasterShellReproduction.note: Tests and referenced shell files extracted from the base commit into an isolated directory. Reproduces the nine shell failures seen in the broad run, plus a third resolver test that the maxfail stop had not reached.
